test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.**

He __lost his heart__ because he could not cope with the difficult situation.
solution:
The correct answer is **'lost heart'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here, **'lost heart'** should be used instead of **'lost his heart'.**
